orphaned_mirror.title: Recorder Downsampler: mirror with no live source

init.title: {mirror} has no matching source
init.description: The source `{source}` is no longer mirrored by any rule — it was disabled or removed from your configuration — so this leftover mirror records no data. Choose how to handle it. Recorder Downsampler never deletes a mirror on its own; if the source comes back, the mirror resumes and this issue clears automatically.
